nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.name: Spirit of the Forest
nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.description: Nature's Prophet gains %damage_per_tree_pct%%% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values and with larger radius. Treants also possess this ability.
nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.note0: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.note1: Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.

nature's_prophet_sprout.name: Sprout
nature's_prophet_sprout.description: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
nature's_prophet_sprout.lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note0: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note1: Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note2: A Tango that consumes a tree created by Sprout provides double the heal duration.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_description: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, trapping it in place, and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note0: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note1: Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note2: A Tango that consumes a tree created by Sprout provides double the heal duration.

nature's_prophet_teleportation.name: Teleportation
nature's_prophet_teleportation.description: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.lore: The Prophet keeps his sentinel over the forest, protecting it when in need.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.note0: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.note1: When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.name: Nature's Call
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.description: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.lore: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.note0: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.

nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.name: Wrath of Nature
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.description: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit. Search Radius: %radius%
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.lore: Nature's Prophet calls Verodicia's fury to strike down those who might ravage the wilderness.
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.note0: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.note1: Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.
